description: A provider block for Ollama that names the adapter, the address, and one model. It defines the identifier opencode uses for that model.

steps.description: This appends a provider to `opencode.json`, as a sibling of `$schema`. A provider tells opencode where models come from. The course runs on Ollama, so nothing you type leaves your laptop.
The provider is named `ollama`. `npm` is the adapter package that speaks the endpoint's dialect, and `name` is the label shown in the interface.
`options` holds the address. `baseURL` is `http://localhost:11434/v1`, which is right when opencode runs on the same machine as Ollama.
`models` lists what the endpoint serves. Here it holds one entry, `llama3.2`, with a display name.

steps.question: A provider key and a model key join with a slash. Which identifier does this block define?

title: Adding the Local Ollama Provider
